Nomura has maintained its Buy rating on InterGlobe Aviation with a target price of Rs 6,000, saying visibility remains low on the new airfare rules that the government is expected to notify within two weeks.

According to a news report on proceedings related to petition, the government would notify new rules related to airfares under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024, within two weeks."Overall, we think visibility remains low on the new rules.

Nevertheless, our base case is higher oversight/transparency on the margin on airfares and stronger disclosures related to fares/ancillary components rather than direct government intervention," Nomura said in a note dated October 17.
Emkay Global Financials research report on HDFC BankHDFC Bank reported PAT of Rs195bn/ROA of 1.8%, broadly in line with our estimates.

Loan growth improved further to 16.4% yoy, driven by broadbased growth across segments and a pickup in retail, while growth excluding FCNR(B) leverage remained healthy at 14.4% yoy.
